systems.system: National Civil Identification and Authentication System (SNIAC) / National Identification Card (CNI)
systems.tiers: national; listed as Cabo Verde's foundational ID system and credential, with a digital ID coded 'Yes' at data collection in 2024; adult coverage estimated from 2019 administrative data

note: Global identity-coverage dataset; Cabo Verde appears as one of four Sub-Saharan economies with an operational digital ID in 2024 and in the annex table of foundational ID systems. Nothing on how civil registration offices record births or deaths.
